The statement is about cutting the "disadvantage gap" — a reference to educational attainment or outcomes inequality between disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged students. This is a classic education policy goal (reducing achievement gaps tied to socioeconomic status).

The specific mechanism: reducing educational outcome inequality linked to socioeconomic disadvantage.

Primary: I2 (Education and Research Institutions — educational attainment/achievement gaps)
Secondary: I3 (Welfare, Well-Being, and Poverty — socioeconomic disadvantage dimension)
